mentions.name: Caravella
mentions.description: Open source Android app for splitting group expenses on trips, in shared flats and at events. Requires no account and has no ads or tracking, keeping all data on the phone. Groups are shared directly between friends' phones over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth using QR-code pairing with end-to-end encryption and no server involved. Expenses can be added by voice or by reading a receipt with the camera. Version 2.4 in development adds a simpler way to invite people into a group and settling up with the fewest payments.
mentions.source_excerpt: Caravella, an open source Android app to split group expenses for trips, shared flats and events. No account, no ads, no tracking: everything stays on your phone.
mentions.author: calca
